function: Joint BS precoding and STAR-RIS phase-shift and amplitude design maximizing the user sum rate, learned by a heterogeneous GNN (pp. 1, 3-4).
system: BS with Nt=16 antennas serving K single-antenna users through L=4 distributed STAR-RISs of M elements in energy-splitting mode, no direct link; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: Heterogeneous GNN (BHGNN, T=3 layers of FCNN message passing, permutation equivariant), unsupervised training on the negative sum rate; Lagrangian loss for QoS (pp. 7-9).
data_channel: Own Rician-fading simulator with path loss 32.6+36.7log10(d) dB and ULA/UPA steering vectors; 50,000 realizations, 45,000 for training and 5,000 for testing (p. 9).
test_conditions: Trained for (Nt,L,M,K)=(16,4,4,8) and tested on other numbers of users, STAR-RISs and elements, and on user areas unseen in training (pp. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: AO-SCA, AO-SCA-EXH, random phase shift, single centralized STAR-RIS. Learned: CNN [35], HomoGNN [18], HetGNN [21] (pp. 9-10).
metrics: Sum rate (also relative to AO-SCA), QoS violation degree, training convergence, CPU running time (pp. 10-11).
complexity: BHGNN order O(LM Nt^2+K Nt^2+T Nt); CPU time 25.7-43.3 ms versus 177.4-1271.7 ms for AO-SCA (Table III) (pp. 9, 11).
q1_support: p. 9: "between the BS and STAR-RISs and between STAR-RISs and users follow the Rician fading channel models"; a custom simulator, and no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model and no measured data are named.
q2_support: p. 9: "and is tested with different settings to show its generalization capability robust to various settings"; p. 11: "Although most of the user locations are unseen in the testing phase" (Table II and Fig. 5 vary users, STAR-RISs and elements).
q3_support: p. 10: "the CNN, HomoGNN, and HetGNN models underperform compared to BHGNN" (sum rate, Fig. 5); p. 10: "Random Phase shift: We optimize beamforming vectors, while the phase shift and amplitude of the STAR-RISs are randomized"; AO-SCA on p. 9.
q4_support: p. 11: "we compare the computational cost of the two proposed schemes in terms of average CPU running time in Table III"; p. 9 gives the order O(LM Nt^2 + K Nt^2 + T Nt).
q5_support: p. 9: "50,000 channel realizations are generated as dataset"; simulated by the authors, and no code or data link or DOI is given anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included as area 3 (joint active and passive beamforming of a distributed STAR-RIS system). The path loss 32.6+36.7log10(d) dB is given without any 3GPP citation and the rest of the channel is a custom Rician model, so q1 is 0. q3 rests on CNN [35], HomoGNN [18] and HetGNN [21], extended by the authors to this system, against AO-SCA and random phase shift (p. 9-10).
